params.from: Bidder address (must be the EIP-3009 signer).
params.salt: Random value chosen by the signer to make the nonce unique.
params.validAfter: Signature not valid before this timestamp.
params.validBefore: Signature not valid after this timestamp.

params.lotId: ID of the lot to cancel.

params.durationSecs: Auction length in seconds. Must be > 0.
params.lotURI: Metadata URI for the lot (becomes the GavelLot tokenURI).
params.minIncrement: Minimum bid increment in USDC 6-dec units.
params.reserve: Minimum bid in USDC 6-dec units. Capped at MAX_RESERVE.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Renouncing ownership is disabled — doing so while paused would      permanently prevent unpause and brick list/bid.

params.lotId: ID of the lot to settle.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bid(uint256,uint256).notice: Place a bid. Pulls USDC from the caller. Credits any outbid         previous bidder to the claimable mapping (never transfers directly).

bidWithAuthorization(uint256,uint256,add.notice: Gasless bid via a single EIP-3009 ReceiveWithAuthorization signature. Security model: the nonce passed to USDC is computed as     keccak256(abi.encode(address(this), block.chainid, lotId, amount, salt)) which binds every bid parameter and this contract's address into the nonce. USDC verifies the caller's signature over (from, to, amount, validAfter, validBefore, nonce), so a relayer cannot change lotId, amount, or chain without breaking the signature.  receiveWithAuthorization also enforces msg.sender == to, preventing replay as a plain ERC-3009 transfer. USDC's own used-nonce bitmap prevents replay of the same signature twice.

cancel(uint256).notice: Cancel a lot that has received no bids. Returns the NFT and bond         to the seller. Only callable by the seller or the contract owner.

claim().notice: Withdraw the caller's full claimable USDC balance.

claimable(address).notice: Claimable USDC balances for outbid bidders and settled sellers.         Pull-pattern: we never push to a bidder address because Arc reverts         transfers to blocklisted addresses and one bad address must not         freeze the auction.

confirmDelivery(uint256).notice: Confirm delivery by the winner and release seller bond.

dispute(uint256).notice: Raise a dispute before bond timeout.

list(string,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: List a lot for auction. Mints a GavelLot NFT and escrows it in         the LotVault. Pulls reserve-sized seller bond from the caller.

pause().notice: Halt list() and bid(). settle() and claim() remain callable.

releaseBondAfterTimeout(uint256).notice: Release seller bond after timeout if no dispute was raised.

reputationWriter().notice: Optional ReputationWriter; address(0) means not set.         If set, clean-sale count is checked to discount the seller bond.

resolveDispute(uint256,bool).notice: Resolve a dispute and release bond to winner (seller fault) or seller.

resolveDisputeTimeout(uint256).notice: Permissionless fallback: if the owner has not resolved a dispute         within DISPUTE_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT, anyone may call this to release         the bond to the seller. Prevents bonds from being locked forever.

setReputationWriter(address).notice: Set the ReputationWriter address. Only callable by owner.         Set to address(0) to disable reputation-based bond sizing.

settle(uint256).notice: Settle a concluded auction. Atomically transfers the lot NFT to         the winner and credits the seller with bid proceeds.         With no bids, returns both the NFT and the bond to the seller.
